summary: Build board-ready cyber oversight, risk reporting, and incident governance skills. Enroll in five practical days of executive-focused training.
lede: Cybersecurity governance training helps board members and senior executives oversee cyber risk, accountability, and incident readiness. Participants practice scoring cyber scenarios, reviewing control and supplier risks, setting escalation paths, and preparing board dashboards and incident oversight documents. The focus is on turning technical findings into clear oversight decisions and useful executive reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for senior leaders who oversee cybersecurity accountability, risk reporting, and incident governance across the enterprise. Board Directors responsible for cybersecurity oversight and challenge. Chief Executive Officers managing enterprise cyber priorities and escalation. Chief Risk Officers aligning cyber risk with enterprise risk appetite. Chief Financial Officers reviewing material cyber exposure and recovery cost. Chief Information Security Officers translating technical risk into board reporting. Chief Information Officers coordinating security, resilience, and technology governance. General Counsels overseeing legal exposure, disclosure, and incident response. Audit Committee Chairs reviewing control assurance and breach preparedness. Enterprise Risk Managers maintaining cyber risk registers and heatmaps. Internal Audit Leaders testing cyber controls and board reporting quality.
prerequisites: Participants should have experience in board oversight, executive management, enterprise risk, internal audit, legal risk, information security, or governance. A working understanding of cybersecurity terminology, incident response, and basic risk reporting is recommended. No coding or programming is required; the course focuses on conceptual awareness and operational application, not technical engineering. Familiarity with board packs, risk registers, policy documents, and control reports will help you get the most from the exercises.
